# agentic-comments

Comment threads and suggestions anchored to any content, from people and agents.

Keywords: comments,threads,mentions,suggestions,annotations,collaboration,agents,yjs,mcp.

- SDK: import { summarizeText, dispatchText } from "agentic-comments".
- CLI: agentic-comments summary --text "...".
- MCP: run agentic-comments mcp, then call summarize_text.

## Docs
